setup_name: Growth-fundamentals swing with fixed 8-10% stop
universe_filter: accelerating quarterly EPS and revenue growth, return on equity around 25%, strong analyst ranking; stock in uptrend with index uptrend
conditions: fundamental screen passes
index (S&P 500) in uptrend
stock already trending up
entry_trigger: technical timing on an existing uptrend (unspecified indicator)
target_or_exit: pre-defined expected gain (example 8-10%); then trail stop tightly; typical hold 1-6 weeks, longer if trend persists
management: trail stop upward; tighten hard once target reached
stated_edge: earnings growth drives prices; three of four stocks follow the index trend
data_needed: fundamentals (EPS growth, ROE)
mcf_translation: daily bars: long when SPY > 50-day MA and stock > 50-day MA; 8% hard stop; at +8% move stop to breakeven-plus/trailing 3%; fundamentals filter not available

setup_name: Short the collapsing pump-and-dump
universe_filter: low-priced stock that has spiked multi-day on promotion/hype (press-release campaign, social hype) with weak fundamentals (little cash, going-concern, insiders with cheap shares)
conditions: stock already spiked strongly over several days on promotion
signs the pump is ending (momentum stalls)
entry_trigger: short once the move shows signs of collapsing (not specified precisely)
target_or_exit: take 10-30% of the drop
management: may hold 1-3 days waiting for the collapse
stated_edge: promoted stocks are lifted to let insiders sell or finance; once buying stops they collapse 50-75%
stated_stats: anecdotal: single-day collapses of 20-70% on shown trades
data_needed: promotion/news flags, SEC filings, short-locate availability, sub-$5 universe
mcf_translation: daily bars: universe price < $5 with 3-day gain > 100%; short the first day close < prior-day low (first red day); stop above the prior-day high; exit at -20% or at close

setup_name: Short-term S&P 500 dip-buying mean reversion
time_of_day: orders placed pre-open from end-of-day data
universe_filter: S&P 500 members
conditions: stock pulled back / weak over recent days (exact oscillator not given)
long only, buying into weakness
entry_trigger: pre-placed order computed from prior close (likely limit below close; not specified)
target_or_exit: short hold, average ~3 days
management: high frequency: 800-1000 trades/yr across the universe
stated_edge: large caps mean-revert after short-term weakness; frequency gives consistency
stated_stats: 22-45% annual return in one recent year; ~800-1000 trades/yr; avg hold 3 days
data_needed: historical S&P 500 membership to avoid survivorship bias
mcf_translation: daily bars: S&P 500 stock above 200-day MA, RSI(2) or 3-day decline extreme, buy limit ~2-3% below prior close next day, exit on close > prior high or after 3-5 days

setup_name: Small-cap momentum breakout trend following
universe_filter: stocks outside the top 100; index/regime filter implied
conditions: price breakout to new highs (buy strength)
market regime up (revert to cash when market falls)
entry_trigger: breakout signal on daily close
target_or_exit: exit on trend reversal / trailing stop; average hold 6-8 months
management: portfolio of positions, fixed fractional sizing ~0.5-0.8% risk each
stated_edge: stocks must trend; small losses, occasional large winners (example +87%)
stated_stats: ~50% win rate, winners ~3x losers; ~25 trades/yr; -12% one year
data_needed: ASX data; would be US small caps for MCF
mcf_translation: daily bars: US small caps, close at 52-week/20-week high while index > 200-day MA; 10% or ATR trailing stop

setup_name: RSI 30-35 pullback buy in a long-term uptrend
universe_filter: index above its 50, 100 and 200-day moving averages
conditions: price > 50, 100 and 200-day SMA
daily RSI(14) falls to ~30-35
entry_trigger: buy at the close when RSI reaches 30-35
target_or_exit: sell when daily RSI reaches ~65-70
management: may also sell bearish call credit spreads at the RSI high
stated_edge: oversold readings inside a strong uptrend mark swing lows
mcf_translation: daily bars on SPY/QQQ/large caps: close > SMA50,100,200 and RSI14 <= 35 -> buy close; exit close when RSI14 >= 65

setup_name: Range breakout to all-time high with 5-EMA/10-SMA trail
universe_filter: stock in an extended sideways range
conditions: price ranged for a long period
close breaks out of the range to a new all-time high
entry_trigger: buy on the breakout close
target_or_exit: trail with close below the 10-day SMA, tightening to the 5-day EMA if the move accelerates
management: end-of-day stops only; risk 1% of capital
stated_edge: new highs out of long bases start trends; trailing captures the bulk
mcf_translation: daily bars: 60-day range width < X% and close > all-time (or 252-day) high -> buy; exit on close < SMA10 (or EMA5 after +2 ATR)

setup_name: S&P 500 200-day MA reclaim
universe_filter: S&P 500 index
conditions: index closes back above its 200-day SMA
entry_trigger: buy at the close above the 200-day
target_or_exit: trail on 10-day SMA, then 5-day EMA if trend accelerates
management: end-of-day stops; size so loss to stop <= 1% of capital
stated_edge: long-term trend filter keeps you on the right side of the market
mcf_translation: daily SPY: cross above SMA200 -> long; exit close < SMA200 initially, later close < SMA10

setup_name: Gann 50% level + double/triple bottom
universe_filter: markets in a clear larger trend or at a major turning point
conditions: price has fallen 50% from a major top, or retraced 50% of a prior low-to-high range
a double or triple bottom forms at that level (support tested before)
additional confluence: timing rule or volume behaviour (needs 3-4 factors)
entry_trigger: swing-chart reversal signal off the level (daily swing turns up)
target_or_exit: half off at a high-probability target (e.g. prior swing high); remainder trailed with the swing chart
management: add new units on subsequent swing signals; skip if entry-to-stop risk too large
stated_edge: informed holders bought at that level before and buy again; if the level breaks, the reverse trade (short the break) is also high probability
stated_stats: claims ~90% chance of some profit if managed (unverified)
mcf_translation: daily bars: find swing range (pivot low L to pivot high H); when low within 1% of (L+H)/2 and within 1.5% of a prior pivot low, buy on close above prior day high; stop below the pivot low; scale half at H-retest; mirror: short close below the double-bottom level

setup_name: Double-top retest failure short
universe_filter: stock that topped at a level, pulled back ~20%, and returned to the top
conditions: prior high made
price retraces then rallies back to that high
selling appears on the retest (fails to hold above)
entry_trigger: swing-chart turns down from the retest
target_or_exit: half at first target, rest trailed
management: as above
stated_edge: informed sellers sell again at the same price and trapped buyers from the first top exit at breakeven
mcf_translation: daily bars: high within 1% of a prior 20-120 day pivot high after a >=10% pullback, then close below prior day low -> short; stop above the higher of the two tops

setup_name: Accumulation footprint breakout (tape reading)
universe_filter: one to a few names being watched for large-player activity
conditions: repeated large buying in blocks absorbing supply at a level (footprints on tape)
market backdrop supportive
entry_trigger: build position while accumulation is visible, before the release/breakout
target_or_exit: sell into strength in pieces as the breakout runs; mostly out by the top
management: scale out progressively; exit when tape turns
stated_edge: big players leave footprints; once their accumulation ends, sharp breakouts follow
data_needed: Level 2 and time-and-sales prints, options flow
mcf_translation: rough proxy: 5-min bars with tight range near a level on rising volume (volume up, range down for several bars) followed by a break of that level; exits in thirds into strength

setup_name: Fade the multi-day vertical spike in a listed small cap
time_of_day: any; while the stock is most volatile and liquid
universe_filter: top % gainers, listed, >= ~$5M dollar volume, news/earnings-driven run (e.g. $2 to $5 in a few days)
conditions: stock has gone near-vertical for several days on news
appears overextended; momentum stalling
entry_trigger: short when the spike stalls / turns (discretionary timing)
stop: break above the high of the run (new highs since the move started) - cover, never add
target_or_exit: 5-15% decline, take the predictable piece and move on
management: do not hold for the full month-long fade; do not average up
stated_edge: listed small-cap news spikes tend to fade back over the following weeks, like OTC pump-and-dumps but slower
data_needed: short borrow availability/cost
mcf_translation: daily bars: price $1-20, 3-day return > 100%, dollar volume > $5M; next day short on 5-min break below opening range low or first red 5-min bar below VWAP; stop above run high; target -10% or close

setup_name: Promotion-high breakout (multi-week / 52-week daily breakout)
universe_filter: stock in an active multi-week promotion/run with high volume
conditions: identify the highest price reached since the run began
price breaks above that high (new run high / multi-week high)
entry_trigger: buy as price trades through the prior run high
target_or_exit: hold for 1-3 day squeeze, sell into spike
management: size so the distance to the breakout level fits dollar risk
stated_edge: new highs in a controlled promotion attract a fresh buying rush and short squeeze
data_needed: OTC data and promotion flags; listed small caps only in MCF
mcf_translation: daily bars: stock up >100% over 20 days, buy stop at 20-day high + 1 tick, stop at prior day low, exit after 1-3 days or on close below prior day low

setup_name: VWAP bias trend-with trade in liquid large caps
universe_filter: highly liquid large and mega caps, not news-driven names
conditions: determine bias from price relative to session VWAP and how price interacts with it (holding above and pulling away = bullish; below = bearish)
heavy volume pulling VWAP toward price confirms participation
short-period RSI used only as timing confirmation
entry_trigger: enter in bias direction (partial size) once direction is clear; pullbacks toward VWAP give the safer entry
stop: thesis invalidated (not specified precisely; implicitly a decisive move back through VWAP)
target_or_exit: capture the middle portion of the move rather than top/bottom
management: partial sizing, add if confirmed
stated_edge: institutions benchmark execution to VWAP so price reacts at it; only 2-3 signals a day define the major moves
mcf_translation: 5-min bars, top 100 liquid stocks: after 10:00, if close > VWAP for N bars and VWAP slope up, buy first pullback to within 0.1% of VWAP that closes back above; stop on 5-min close below VWAP minus 0.2%; exit at 2R or 15:45. Mirror for shorts

setup_name: Balance failure (failed breakout of a balance area)
instrument: futures (ES, CL, GC); applicable to liquid stocks/ETFs
universe_filter: liquid instrument that has formed a multi-session or intraday balance (tight range, fat volume profile)
conditions: market in balance: tight consolidation with a well-defined high and low
price pushes beyond one extreme (stops above highs / below lows get hit)
the breakout fails to hold and price comes back inside the balance quickly and forcefully
entry_trigger: enter in the opposite direction once price re-enters the balance after the poke outside
stop: beyond the extreme of the failed breakout
target_or_exit: the opposite side of the balance area (stops resting there fuel the move)
management: not specified
stated_edge: larger players push through the range to trigger stops for liquidity, then reverse; trapped breakout buyers are flushed
data_needed: futures data for original instruments; volume profile approximated
mcf_translation: 5-min or daily bars: define balance = prior N-bar (e.g. 2-5 day) high/low with range < X ATR; signal when a bar trades above balance high then a 5-min close back below it within 3 bars -> short; stop above the excursion high; target balance low (or mid at 1R). Mirror for lows

setup_name: Balance-area extremes rotation
universe_filter: instrument in balance (range-bound profile)
conditions: market inside established balance area
price reaches balance high or low
entry_trigger: fade at the extreme (limit orders resting at the edge)
target_or_exit: opposite extreme of the balance
management: avoid trading the middle
stated_edge: extremes of balance are where responsive buyers/sellers act; middle is chop
mcf_translation: daily/5-min: when prior 5-day range is narrow relative to 20-day ATR, place limit buy at range low and sell at range high; stop 0.25 ATR beyond; target other side

setup_name: Weak pullback in short-term trend (simple/complex pullback)
instrument: futures (CL, e-minis); applicable to liquid stocks/ETFs
time_of_day: his US session window (~3 hours from open)
universe_filter: directional, liquid instrument
conditions: short-term bias established on 1-min within 5-min S/R structure (e.g. higher highs/higher lows)
price pulls back against the bias
pullback shows weakness (small overlapping bars, low momentum) - stand aside if the pullback is strong
entry_trigger: enter with trend where pullback traders are trapped (e.g. break of the pullback's last swing / first bar back in trend direction)
stop: very tight, just beyond the pullback extreme; scratch if no immediate follow-through
target_or_exit: prior swing / next S/R level; partial scale-outs
management: re-enter after a scratch if premise valid; max two full losses per setup area
stated_edge: counter-trend traders in the pullback are forced to exit, adding order flow in trend direction
data_needed: 1-min bars for exact timing (MCF has 5-min)
mcf_translation: 5-min bars: trend = close > EMA20 and EMA20 rising; pullback of 2-4 bars with average range < 0.7x prior impulse bars; buy stop above the high of the last pullback bar; stop below pullback low; target prior swing high or 2R

setup_name: Breakout pullback (BPB) at higher-timeframe S/R
universe_filter: liquid instrument with clear 5-min S/R levels
conditions: price breaks a 5-min support/resistance level
first pullback retests the broken level without strength
entry_trigger: entry as pullback stalls at the broken level (lower-timeframe confirmation)
stop: tight, just back through the level
target_or_exit: next S/R level
management: scratch/re-enter; partial profits
stated_edge: successful breaks get a retest where late traders and trapped faders add to the breakout direction
mcf_translation: 5-min bars: level = prior-day high or 30-min opening range high; after a close above it, buy on first pullback that holds within 0.1% of the level and closes up; stop 0.15% below level; target 2R

setup_name: Contrarian RSI extreme with ATR exhaustion exit
time_of_day: any; entries timed on hourly chart
universe_filter: market overextended on monthly, weekly and daily charts
conditions: RSI well above 70 (or well below 30) on higher timeframes
optional fundamental/event catalyst that could spark a reversal
hourly chart shows a turn (e.g. higher low after the oversold low)
entry_trigger: hourly reversal signal at the extreme (e.g. hourly higher low for longs)
stop: beyond the extreme; risk ~1% of equity
target_or_exit: exit when the move from entry reaches about one average daily range (ATR); always > 1:1 reward:risk
management: a few positions per week; hold days
stated_edge: stretched markets mean-revert, and the day's move tends to stop once it has covered the average range
mcf_translation: daily bars: RSI14 < 25 and close < SMA20 - 2*ATR; enter on first 60-min (or 5-min aggregated) higher low; stop below the low; exit when price gains 1x ATR14 from entry or after 5 days. Mirror for shorts

setup_name: Fade inflated implied volatility after unusual call buying (buy-write)
time_of_day: after the unusual activity has become public
universe_filter: options with day volume >= 4-5x open interest, aggressive buying at the offer
conditions: unusual call buying detected and widely followed
implied volatility pushed to an extreme by chasing buyers
entry_trigger: sell the overpriced calls and buy stock against them (delta hedge)
target_or_exit: buy back calls as implied volatility normalises once the buying subsides
management: keep position delta-hedged
stated_edge: late followers overpay for options; IV mean-reverts after the frenzy
data_needed: options chain with volume, open interest and implied volatility history
mcf_translation: not directly; could log unusual-option-activity as a catalyst flag for stock setups if an options feed is added

setup_name: Consolidation breakout in an uptrend with group strength
universe_filter: S&P 100, NASDAQ 100, top-volume S&P 400 and Russell 2000 names; stock's industry group showing several strong charts
conditions: prior uptrend (e.g. rally from 23 to 30)
sideways consolidation for about a month
overall market acting well (not range-bound) for longer holds
2+ peers in the same group also setting up/strong
entry_trigger: buy as price moves above the consolidation resistance
stop: short-term trades: tight, just below breakout level; theme trades: looser, below pattern
target_or_exit: short-term: 4-10% in days to a week; theme trades: hold months while group trend intact
management: add only higher, after breakout-rest-rebreak or pullback to prior resistance/MA; trade around a core position
stated_edge: group momentum plus market tailwind carries breakouts; isolated breakouts fail more
data_needed: industry/sector classification for group-strength filter
mcf_translation: daily bars: 20-day range < 12% after a 60-day gain > 20%; SPY > SMA50 and SMA50 rising; >= 2 sector peers within 5% of 20-day highs; buy stop at 20-day high; stop below 20-day low or 1.5 ATR; exit +8% or 10 days in choppy regime, else trail SMA20

setup_name: Short promotional/overvalued biotech with 52-week-high stop
universe_filter: biotech with weak fundamentals/red flags, promotional news flow
conditions: company looks overvalued or shady based on filings/press releases
stock below its 52-week high
entry_trigger: short on news-driven strength or when detail of a release disappoints versus headline
stop: exit immediately if price breaks the 52-week high
target_or_exit: not specified; usually under 5 days for trades
management: max loss defined before entry and size set from it
stated_edge: biotech valuations rest on uncertain future approvals; promotion inflates them
data_needed: news feed, sector classification, borrow availability
mcf_translation: daily bars: biotech universe (needs sector data), gap up > 10% on news that closes below open (red candle) -> short next day below prior low; stop at 52-week high or day high; exit within 5 days

setup_name: Earnings/PR breakout with strong daily chart
time_of_day: open and through the day; secondary entries later
universe_filter: stocks in play: earnings surprise or news/PR catalyst, gap, very high relative volume, good daily chart pattern (breaking out of a base)
conditions: catalyst forces re-valuation (surprise)
daily chart shows a base/breakout setup
high relative volume confirms participation
entry_trigger: intraday pattern entries in direction of the gap (breakouts, pullbacks); if first move missed, wait for lower-risk secondary entry
target_or_exit: ride while in play; can last days to weeks
management: daily max loss and 50% give-back cutoff apply
stated_edge: price discovery after a surprise creates order flow independent of the market
data_needed: earnings dates / news flag improves it (gap+rvol proxy available)
mcf_translation: 5-min bars: gap > 4% on earnings day (or any gap with rvol > 3), daily close prior day within 5% of 60-day high; long on break of 15-min opening range high above VWAP; stop below OR low or VWAP; trail on 5-min higher lows; exit close

setup_name: Afternoon (2 PM) breakout in hot momentum stock
universe_filter: strong in-play momentum stock (large gap/run that day, high rvol)
conditions: stock ran strongly in the morning
consolidates midday (lunch range)
entry_trigger: break above the midday consolidation high / day high in the early afternoon
target_or_exit: into the close
management: not specified
stated_edge: real momentum names commonly make one more push in the afternoon
mcf_translation: 5-min bars: stocks up > 8% with rvol > 3 at 12:00; define 11:30-13:30 range; buy stop at range high (or HOD) between 13:30-15:00; stop at range low; exit 15:55

setup_name: Multi-day in-play run then short the over-extension
universe_filter: stock gapped ~50% on major news and keeps running for days (example $3 to ~$11)
conditions: day-trade long while trend intact
after several days the move becomes extremely extended
entry_trigger: switch to shorts once extended (exact trigger not given)
target_or_exit: trade the decline back down over following days
management: keep the name on the radar for weeks
stated_edge: once in play, a stock keeps attracting volume both ways for weeks
data_needed: news catalyst flag
mcf_translation: daily: after gap > 30% with rvol > 5, track for 15 days; long 5-min ORB while close > prior close; once 5-day gain > 150%, short first 5-min break below VWAP after 10:00; stop HOD

setup_name: Strong impulse then consolidation near highs (with-trend continuation)
universe_filter: relative-strength screen leaders; sector with multiple names showing the same pattern
conditions: market made a strong move up recently (weekly and/or daily)
price holds near the highs in a consolidation rather than collapsing
daily lows tested and held (firm support on pullbacks)
entry_trigger: not specified (breakout of consolidation or buy pullback in it)
target_or_exit: swing hold targeting ~2 weeks; longer if trend persists
management: unit size small relative to account; consistent execution
stated_edge: momentum after strong impulses with shallow consolidation has a small but persistent statistical edge
mcf_translation: daily bars: 20-day return in top decile and > 2 ATR impulse; next 5-15 days range < 50% of the impulse with close within 5% of high; buy stop at consolidation high; stop at consolidation low; time exit 10 days or trail SMA10

setup_name: The Money Trade (catalyst gap and go)
time_of_day: entry after ~10:15-10:30 ET, once opening price discovery is done
universe_filter: strongly positive changing fundamentals (e.g. full-year guidance raised > 10%), gap up >= 3% premarket, high relative volume, no overhead resistance on longer-term charts
conditions: first ~45 min: price discovery, chops but trends slightly higher
by 10:15-10:30 the gap is holding
forms a higher consolidation area above VWAP
relative volume remains high
entry_trigger: long from/through the higher consolidation above VWAP (break of consolidation high)
stop: below the consolidation / VWAP (controlled long-side risk)
target_or_exit: ride trend intraday; may hold 1-3 days as follow-on buyers arrive
management: size up on A+ versions; intraday stop and give-back rules apply
stated_edge: news-driven re-rating attracts buyers for 1-3 days; trading with both the news trend and price trend
data_needed: guidance/news flag (gap+rvol proxy available); longer-term resistance from daily bars
mcf_translation: 5-min bars: gap >= 3%, rvol(first 30 min) >= 2, daily close-to-52w-high distance shows no resistance within 5%; 09:30-10:15 range forms; after 10:15 if price > VWAP and above opening price, buy break of 10:15-10:30 consolidation high; stop below VWAP or consolidation low; exit 15:55 or hold overnight if close in top 25% of range

setup_name: Second-day play (break of day-1 key level)
time_of_day: day 2 after the catalyst; any time the level breaks
universe_filter: stock very weak (or strong) on day 1 after earnings/news with a clear key level set on day 1 (e.g. day-1 low)
conditions: day 1: large earnings/news move, closes weak
negative catalyst (e.g. poorly received product)
day 2: price trades below the day-1 low (and any nearby higher key level)
entry_trigger: short below the day-1 low (if trading momentum, also act at the higher nearby level)
target_or_exit: momentum: quick follow-through; swing: hold for continuation
management: decide in advance momentum vs swing treatment; be consistent across related levels
stated_edge: follow-through after a clean break of a day-1 level when the news supports it
data_needed: earnings dates improve the filter
mcf_translation: day 1: |gap| > 4% with rvol > 3 and close in bottom 25% of range; day 2: short on 5-min close below day-1 low; stop day-1 low + 0.3 ATR(5m*?) or above 5-min swing high; exit 15:55; mirror long for strong closers above day-1 high

setup_name: Momentum continuation: 2% pivot move to new 20-day high
time_of_day: intraday trigger or end of day
universe_filter: stocks in currently hot industries (many setups in same group), recent IPOs preferred; prior up-leg of 1 week to 3+ months
conditions: initial up-leg establishes momentum
consolidation through time or slight price pullback
price > 5-day MA and 5-day MA > 20-day MA
tight range with closely clustered closes ('tight is good')
entry_trigger: move of at least ~2% that makes a new 20-day high (pivot move, not just a tick through)
target_or_exit: sell into strength after 3-10 days or 5-30% gain
management: 7-8 positions = fully invested; rotate out of laggards into better setups
stated_edge: stocks range ~80% of the time and make most of their move in 15-20% of days; industry momentum gives follow-through
stated_stats: about 7 of 10 trades profitable in good environments, 2 of them making ~80% of profits (illustrative)
data_needed: industry classification; IPO dates
mcf_translation: daily bars: SMA5 > SMA20, close > SMA5, 10-day range < 1.5 ATR, prior 60-day gain > 20%; enter when price >= max(20-day high, prior close*1.02); stop below 10-day low; exit after 10 days or on first close < SMA5 after +10%

setup_name: Post-earnings-announcement drift consolidation (anticipation buy)
universe_filter: stock that gapped up on a favourable earnings reaction (big surprise, earnings acceleration)
conditions: earnings gap up with strong market reaction
subsequent sideways consolidation that holds the gap (through time, not price)
market environment favourable
entry_trigger: buy inside the consolidation in anticipation of continuation (or on breakout above it)
target_or_exit: sell on strength after continuation leg
management: position sizing 0.25-1% risk
stated_edge: post-earnings-announcement drift: positive reactions tend to continue for weeks
data_needed: earnings dates (gap proxy otherwise)
mcf_translation: daily: earnings-day gap > 5% closing in upper half; next 5-15 days hold above gap-day low with range < 8%; buy close inside range or break of range high; stop gap-day low; exit 10 days or +15%

setup_name: Relative-strength leaders after a market correction
universe_filter: stocks that moved sideways or built bases while S&P fell 6-15%
conditions: index correction of ~6-15%
stock holds near highs / builds a new base during the correction
index starts to bounce
entry_trigger: breakout to new 50-day or 52-week high as the market turns up
target_or_exit: hold for multi-week/month trend; partial profits when weekly RSI > 80; exit on heavy-volume large down day (distribution)
management: smaller capital share than swing book
stated_edge: stocks resisting a correction become leaders when it ends
stated_stats: anecdote: biotech base-builders rose 50-200% in 3 months after Sept 2014 dip
mcf_translation: daily: SPY drawdown from 52w high >= 7% then SPY close > SMA10; select stocks with drawdown < 5% from own 52w high during the same window; buy on close at new 50-day high; stop 50-day low; trail SMA50; trim 1/3 when weekly RSI > 80

setup_name: Failed reaction to news - fade rallies all day
time_of_day: after a scheduled release (08:30 data) through the session
universe_filter: index/bond futures on a major data day (payrolls, retail sales, CPI) where the market had positioned ahead
conditions: news that should be bullish (or bearish) triggers an initial move in the expected direction
the move fades and price bleeds the other way (feels heavy)
a second supportive news item also fails to lift price
entry_trigger: sell rallies in the counter-news direction, timing with MACD/stochastic divergences or rally failures
stop: above the post-news high (not specified precisely)
target_or_exit: hold the theme for the session; unfilled gaps as targets
management: trade larger when story and technicals agree
stated_edge: when positioned traders are exhausted after the release, no one is left to push it, and the market reverses for the day
data_needed: economic calendar with consensus vs actual
mcf_translation: SPY 5-min on NFP/CPI/retail-sales days: if first 30 min makes a high above prior close but by 10:30 trades below the opening price and VWAP, short pullbacks to VWAP; stop above first-30-min high; exit 15:55

setup_name: Unfilled gap as intraday target
universe_filter: instrument opened with a gap vs prior close
conditions: gap remains unfilled
market moves back toward the gap area
entry_trigger: trade in direction of the gap fill once price heads toward it (with other reasons)
target_or_exit: prior close (gap fill)
management: used as target more than trigger
stated_edge: markets tend to come back to fill opening gaps
mcf_translation: SPY 5-min: gap 0.3-1% and first 30-min close back below/above open -> trade toward prior close; stop at OR extreme; target prior close

setup_name: Failed chart pattern signal
universe_filter: any liquid market showing a textbook pattern (breakout, flag, head and shoulders)
conditions: a classical pattern triggers (e.g. breakout above range or below neckline)
price reverses back through the pattern, invalidating it (e.g. returns inside the range / beyond the opposite boundary)
entry_trigger: trade in the direction opposite to the original pattern signal once failure is confirmed
stop: beyond the extreme of the failed breakout
target_or_exit: opposite side of the pattern or trailing
management: not specified
stated_edge: traders positioned for the textbook outcome are trapped and must exit
mcf_translation: daily bars: close above 20-day high (breakout) followed within 3 days by a close below the pre-breakout 20-day high -> short next open; stop above breakout high; target 20-day low or 2R. Mirror for failed breakdowns

setup_name: If-then trend plan: dip-to-level or held breakout with contracting bars
instrument: stocks/ETFs (expressed via weekly options or futures)
universe_filter: instrument in a defined trend with a clear range top/level
conditions: Scenario A: price dips back to a predefined support level in the trend direction
Scenario B: price breaks out above the level and holds; 5-6 bars of consolidation above it with shrinking bar size
entry_trigger: A: buy at the level; B: buy the held bid/consolidation above the breakout
stop: A: break of the level that was expected to hold (then consider short if it consolidates below); B: back below the breakout level
target_or_exit: A: top of range / new breakout where others buy; B: trend continuation
management: if the level breaks and price consolidates beneath it, flip to short scenario; if price rips away without setup, skip
stated_edge: pre-planned responses remove prediction bias and give multiple ways to profit in a trend
mcf_translation: 5-min bars with daily trend filter (close > SMA20 daily): level = prior-day high; B: after break, require 5 consecutive 5-min bars above level with declining range -> buy at 6th bar; stop below level; target 2R. A: limit buy at level retest within first 2 hours; stop 0.3% below

setup_name: Daily-uptrend pullback with 30-min higher high above 5-day MA
universe_filter: stocks with a rising 50-day MA on the daily chart
conditions: daily: 50-day MA rising
daily: pullback to prior resistance-turned-support, key MA or retracement level, with volatility contraction and lighter volume
30-min chart (20-40 days): pullback slowing, signs of accumulation; stock has not already run ~10% in prior 3 days
5-day moving average (on 30-min chart) flat or rising
entry_trigger: buy when price makes a higher high above the flat-to-rising 5-day MA on the 30-min chart; set price alerts slightly below the trigger and act on price alone
stop: just below the most recent relevant higher low (30-min chart)
target_or_exit: next resistance level; hold while higher highs and higher lows continue
management: cut size if the broad market is weak (e.g. A/D 2:1 negative); no position into earnings
stated_edge: enters as the intermediate-term trend turns back up inside a longer-term uptrend with a tight, logical stop
data_needed: 30-min bars can be built from 5-min
mcf_translation: daily: SMA50 slope > 0 and close within 3% of SMA20/SMA50 after >= 5% pullback from 20-day high; 30-min bars: SMA over 5 days (65 bars) flat/rising; buy when 30-min high exceeds prior 30-min swing high and price > that SMA; stop below last 30-min higher low; target prior daily high or 2R; skip if earnings within 2 days

setup_name: Event-anchored VWAP support/resistance
universe_filter: stock with a clear event: breakout day, earnings gap or IPO date
conditions: anchor VWAP from the event (breakout day, gap, IPO)
after a run (e.g. 20 to 28), price pulls back toward the anchored VWAP; or rallies up to it from below
entry_trigger: look for buyers at the anchored VWAP on pullbacks (confirm on lower timeframe); treat it as resistance when price rallies to it from below
target_or_exit: prior high (for longs) / prior low (for shorts)
management: use lower-timeframe structure for timing
stated_edge: anchored VWAP marks the average participant's breakeven since the event; behaviour changes there
stated_stats: examples: Alibaba and GoPro rallies stalled near their IPO-anchored VWAP
data_needed: IPO dates for IPO anchors
mcf_translation: daily/5-min: compute AVWAP from breakout day (close > 20-day high on rvol > 2); long when price first touches within 0.5% of AVWAP and next 5-min/daily bar closes above it; stop 1% below AVWAP; target prior swing high

setup_name: Intraday VWAP slope filter
universe_filter: any liquid stock being traded intraday
conditions: session VWAP declining -> no longs
session VWAP rising -> no shorts
entry_trigger: used as a filter for other entries
target_or_exit: n/a
management: n/a
stated_edge: VWAP slope shows whether buyers or sellers control the day's transaction level
mcf_translation: filter for any MCF intraday long: require VWAP(t) > VWAP(t-6 bars) on 5-min; shorts require the opposite

setup_name: Stage 1 to stage 2 breakout
universe_filter: stocks that completed a decline and spent time basing
conditions: stage 1: sideways base with moving averages crossing back and forth (avoid while crossing)
longer-term MAs flatten then begin to turn up
entry_trigger: higher high above the flat-to-advancing longer-term moving averages (breakout from base)
stop: below the base / last higher low
target_or_exit: hold while higher highs and higher lows continue; exit when distribution (stage 3) / breakdown appears
management: anticipate in stage 1, participate in stage 2
stated_edge: trend persistence after supply/demand rebalances
mcf_translation: daily: SMA50 and SMA150 slopes within +/-0.5% over 20 days then SMA50 slope turns positive; buy close above 60-day high; stop below 20-day low; trail on SMA50 close

setup_name: Trend following with volatility-normalised sizing (entry-agnostic)
universe_filter: diversified basket of liquid markets
conditions: position direction follows the prevailing trend (or even a random coin flip in his study)
position size such that 20-day avg daily dollar range per position / equity <= fixed cap (e.g. ~1%)
initial risk to stop <= fixed % of equity
entry_trigger: trend signal (unspecified) - entry quality deliberately de-emphasised
stop: trailing stop at a logical distance giving room for normal movement
target_or_exit: stop-out only; let the big trends run
management: daily recompute volatility/equity; sell down any position exceeding the volatility cap
stated_edge: large trends pay for many small losses; normalising volatility keeps any single market from dominating
mcf_translation: daily bars: as an MCF sizing overlay - shares = (cap% * equity) / ATR20_dollar; for any setup, reduce shares daily if ATR20*shares/equity > cap; test random-entry + 3xATR trailing stop on ETFs as a baseline

setup_name: Takeover-target 'free option' (buy near unconditional bid)
instrument: stocks (ASX; applicable to US merger targets)
universe_filter: companies under a formal, credible takeover offer, ideally unconditional, trading at or just above the bid
conditions: formal bid announced (no rumour trading)
credible bidder and target; downside to the bid price is known and small
reason to expect an improved or competing bid (e.g. earlier rejected higher approaches)
entry_trigger: buy at or very near the offer price after announcement
stop: effectively the bid price (sell into the offer)
target_or_exit: improved/competing bid; exit early if the price runs and remaining reward/risk is poor
management: position size large because risk per share is small (e.g. 1 cent vs 14+ cents upside)
stated_edge: you get an option on a bump without paying option premium; low correlation to the market
stated_stats: example PNA: bid A$1.71, bought ~A$1.72, bumped to ~A$1.85 (~14-15x reward/risk)
data_needed: M&A announcement data with offer terms and conditions
mcf_translation: not with price data alone; could be a separate event-driven sleeve if a deals feed is added (rule: long when price <= offer*1.005 on unconditional cash bids)

setup_name: Morning-window gap-down washout reclaim (index ETF)
universe_filter: index ETFs after a sell-off where shorts are crowded
conditions: market gaps down at the bottom of a range
early selling capitulates (volume spike, washout)
price starts moving back toward unchanged (green)
entry_trigger: buy as the gap-down reverses toward the prior close (pre-planned the night before)
target_or_exit: snap-back toward/above prior close; done by lunch
management: do not play catch-up in the afternoon if the window is missed
stated_edge: emotional money trades the open; trapped shorts fuel the snap-back
stated_stats: 90% of his day-trading cash flow is made before lunch
mcf_translation: SPY/IWM 5-min: gap <= -0.5% at prior-day range low; after first 30 min, buy break above opening-range high or VWAP reclaim; stop below day low; target prior close, time exit 12:00

setup_name: Afternoon fade of exhausted high-flyer making lower highs
universe_filter: stocks that ran hard in the morning (90-95% of range made in first 3-3.5 hours)
conditions: big morning run, then exhaustion
afternoon price puts in lower highs on intraday channels
entry_trigger: short on break of the afternoon lower-high structure
stop: above the most recent lower high / HOD
target_or_exit: close
management: avoid buying afternoon breakouts in these names (often fail into the close)
stated_edge: after the emotional morning, stocks are pinned or fade as traders position for the next day
mcf_translation: 5-min: stocks up > 6% at 12:30 with rvol > 2; after 13:00, two successive lower 5-min swing highs below HOD -> short break of last swing low; stop above last lower high; exit 15:55

setup_name: Pullback to the stock's respected level (50-day MA or support) in an uptrend
universe_filter: stocks in long-term uptrends (bottom-left to top-right charts) near highs
conditions: clear uptrend
pullback into an 'obvious' level the stock has respected: 50-day MA or prior support
signs of exhaustion in the pullback / buyers stepping in
entry_trigger: buy at/near the level when the pullback stalls (discretionary; intraday holds above the level preferred)
stop: close below the level (e.g. close below 50-day MA on a large or bottom-of-range candle) or below the reaction wick; volatility stop ~4 ATR for stocks that respect no level
target_or_exit: hold for months while trend persists; exit on stop
management: add on each subsequent pullback to the level; exit fast if wrong (often next day)
stated_edge: respected levels attract buyers in trends and give a tight logical stop
mcf_translation: daily: close > SMA200 and within 10% of 52w high; stock touched SMA50 >= 2 times in prior 120 days without closing below 2 days in a row; buy when low <= SMA50*1.01 and close > SMA50; exit on 2 closes below SMA50 or close < entry-bar low; pyramid on next touch

setup_name: Long-term 200-day breakout trend following
time_of_day: end of day; stop orders resting
universe_filter: diversified liquid futures across commodities, rates, FX, stock indices
conditions: market makes a new 200-day high (long) or low (short)
entry_trigger: buy stop at 200-day high / sell stop at 200-day low
stop: loose trailing/exit stop (exact rule not given)
target_or_exit: trailing exit; long average holding period
management: position size from per-market risk sheet; stops always in market
stated_edge: large sustained trends occur in some market most years; diversification ensures participation
data_needed: futures data; MCF could proxy with asset-class ETFs
mcf_translation: daily bars on ~20 ETFs (SPY, TLT, GLD, USO, UUP, EFA, ...): long on 200-day high, short on 200-day low, exit on 100-day opposite extreme; ATR-normalised sizing

setup_name: Buy all-time highs in consumer growth brands with a catalyst
universe_filter: consumer-facing growth companies whose products you can observe (restaurants, apparel, consumer tech), liquid
conditions: stock trading at all-time highs (no overhead supply, shorts under pressure)
identifiable growth catalyst (store rollout, product adoption)
strong market
entry_trigger: buy at/near new all-time high
stop: drawdown rule ~10-15% (looser with high conviction and strong market)
target_or_exit: sell in pieces on the way up; exit on price/volume warning signs, especially around earnings
management: pyramid out rather than in
stated_edge: momentum persistence; all-time-high names are under-owned by value-minded investors and short sellers must cover
data_needed: sector tags for consumer filter
mcf_translation: daily: close at all-time (or 252-day) high with SPY > SMA200; buy close; stop 12% trailing from high; trim 1/3 at +25%, +50%

setup_name: Weekly horizontal-boundary pattern, daily close breakout
universe_filter: markets showing a recognisable pattern visible on the weekly chart
conditions: pattern of at least 8-12 weeks (up to years): rectangle, descending/ascending triangle, head-and-shoulders
boundary is horizontal (no diagonal trendlines)
daily chart offers a precise trigger level
entry_trigger: daily close beyond the horizontal boundary
stop: fairly close stop (e.g. back inside pattern / below breakout bar), risk <= 1% of capital
target_or_exit: half the position traded for profit and re-entered on pullbacks; other half held while momentum continues (weeks-months); no mechanical trailing stops
management: exit any loser before the weekend; expect immediate follow-through - lack of it is a warning
stated_edge: large moves follow periods of informed accumulation/distribution that form these patterns
stated_stats: ~40% win rate; 10-15% of trades = all net profit; ~42% CAGR claimed historically
mcf_translation: daily bars: 40-120 day range with top touches within 1.5% at least twice (rectangle/ascending triangle); enter on daily close > range top; stop below breakout bar low (risk <= 1%); exit if close back inside within 3 days or on Friday close if position is red; scale half at 2R, hold rest until close < SMA50

setup_name: RTH session tags overnight (Globex) high or low
time_of_day: after the 09:30 ET open once control is visible
universe_filter: ES regular session
conditions: record overnight session high and low
open lies between them
early auction shows which side dominates (fast drops/slow rallies = sellers)
entry_trigger: enter with the dominant side at a defined-risk pullback, targeting the overnight extreme on that side
target_or_exit: the overnight high (if buyers dominate) or overnight low (if sellers dominate)
management: if no side dominates, keep targets very small
stated_edge: in his ~1,700-day sample, ~97% of RTH sessions touch or exceed the overnight high or low
stated_stats: ~97% of sessions touch ON high or ON low (n~1,700 days)
data_needed: overnight/extended-hours data (SPY premarket bars) or ES futures
mcf_translation: SPY with premarket 5-min bars: ONH/ONL = 04:00-09:29 high/low; at 10:00, if price < VWAP and opening range breaks down, short targeting ONL (and vice versa); stop above 10:00 swing high; first verify the touch-rate statistic on SPY

setup_name: Fifth-day reversal bias after four consecutive lower lows
universe_filter: index that has made four consecutive lower daily lows
conditions: 4 consecutive days of lower lows
historical probability of a 5th lower low is low (his example ~1.5%, should be re-measured)
entry_trigger: favour longs near the prior day's low area where reward exceeds risk; shorts only small with tiny targets
target_or_exit: intraday upside rotation
management: long bias full size; short ideas at 1/4 size
stated_edge: conditional probability of continued lower lows is low after streaks (claimed)
stated_stats: claimed ~1.5% chance of a 5th lower low over ~3,000 days (unverified; likely instrument-specific)
mcf_translation: daily SPY: count consecutive lower lows; on day after 4, buy 5-min reclaim of prior-day low or ORB-high break; stop below prior-day low; exit close. First compute P(lower low | 4 prior lower lows) on SPY/QQQ

setup_name: Failed new value area - return to prior point of control
universe_filter: instrument with a well-defined high-volume node (point of control) from prior session(s)
conditions: price moves away from accepted value to a new price area
it fails to build volume/acceptance there (cannot hold)
entry_trigger: trade back toward the prior point of control once the new area is rejected
stop: beyond the extreme of the failed excursion
target_or_exit: prior point of control (highest-volume price)
management: if the new area is accepted (volume builds), stand aside or follow the move
stated_edge: half of the volume in a value bulge is trapped when price leaves; failure to hold sends price back to fair value
data_needed: volume-at-price; can approximate from 5-min bars (volume by close price)
mcf_translation: 5-min: build prior-day volume profile from bar closes, POC = max-volume price; if today opens > 0.5% away from POC and the first hour fails to extend (range < 0.5x ATR) and price crosses back below opening-range low, trade toward POC; stop beyond OR extreme

setup_name: Simple 10-bar momentum entry (illustrative)
universe_filter: liquid futures market
conditions: close > close of 10 bars ago
entry_trigger: buy next bar
target_or_exit: not specified (one-line exit rule)
management: run as one of many uncorrelated strategies; quit rules predefined
stated_edge: simple momentum persists in some markets; edge validated via walk-forward and Monte Carlo
mcf_translation: daily ETFs: long when close > close[10] (and short when <) next open; exit on opposite signal or N-day time stop; validate with walk-forward on 10 vs alternatives

setup_name: Gap open, failed auction beyond reference, fade to gap close
instrument: futures, FX (Sunday open); applicable to stocks/ETFs
universe_filter: instrument with a large opening gap
conditions: large gap at the open
price extends in the gap direction
breaks a key swing high (for gap up) but cannot close beyond it - auction failure
entry_trigger: fade the move once the failure beyond the reference is confirmed (e.g. bar closes back below the swing high)
target_or_exit: gap close (prior session close)
management: discretionary
stated_edge: traders who chased the gap breakout are trapped; open gaps attract price back
stated_stats: he calls it one of his highest-expectancy setups (no numbers)
mcf_translation: 5-min: gap up > 1% (or ATR-scaled); within first 60 min price exceeds prior-day high (or 5-day high) then a 5-min close back below that level -> short; stop above excursion high; target prior close; mirror for gap down

setup_name: Quiet coil under repeatedly tested resistance - buy for the probe
universe_filter: market with a horizontal resistance tested multiple times
conditions: resistance hit several times
price then goes quiet and trades tightly just under resistance (does not pull back)
entry_trigger: buy inside the range, below resistance, anticipating a probe through it
target_or_exit: a modest probe above resistance (stop run) - not a large breakout; take profit into the probe
management: do not expect a 200-tick follow-through
stated_edge: the market probes above to trigger shorts' stops and breakout buyers before deciding; anticipatory entry beats confirmation buyers
mcf_translation: 5-min/daily: level touched >= 3 times within 0.2%; last 6 bars range < 0.5 ATR and all within 0.5 ATR below level; buy at market; stop below 6-bar low; target level + 0.5 ATR
